newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off after U.S. job data.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off after U.S. job data.

text.p: Austria's ATX index end softer on Friday after stronger-than-expected U.S. nonfarm payrolls and a decline in the U.S. unemployment rate.
Traders see market heading for 1,500 points next week, given the slim turnover of today's trade.
* ATX down 9.03 points, or 0.09 pct, at 1,471.46
* Top gainer brewer Brau Union up 1.56 pct at 847 schillings.
* Leading loser highgrade steelmaker Boehler, down 2.85 pct at 1,020 schillings.
* August ATX future down 11.6 points at 1,470.0 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
